title: Can AI replace teachers? Why UNESCO says the World needs millions more educators
key_facts: 5 Oct 2026 is World Teachers' Day and marks 60 years of the 1966 ILO/UNESCO Recommendation on the Status of Teachers.
UNESCO says technology should support teachers, not replace them.
UNESCO's Global Report on Teachers: the world faces a shortage of 44 million secondary teachers by 2030.
UNICEF notes another 6 million educators are needed when early childhood education is included.
UNESCO's AI Competency Framework for Teachers lists 15 competencies.
UNESCO guidance stresses safeguards, ethics, privacy and human oversight.
quote_evidence: UNESCO says 'technology should support teachers not replace teachers'.
why_it_matters_hint: The teacher shortage means the problem is training teachers, not replacing them.
notes: Explainer with some loose wording; figures attributed to UNESCO/UNICEF.
